_note: The rule sets (W-088m1, D-252): the rows a node evaluates together, and how one is chosen. Each rule row names its set in its own file (ruleSet; ruleSetPosition where the set takes every row in order). selection: EXACTLY_ONE (the only row, or the one that applies), AT_MOST_ONE (a row a year may not hold), ALL_THAT_APPLY (every row, in order). ground: what decides whether a row of several applies — REGIME (the row's regime applicability and the regime's disallowances), or REGIME_AND_CONDITIONS (its conditions too).

ruleSets._note: The part of the capital-gains head a bucket falls in, chosen by its facts (S2 ss.196-198; 1961 ss.111A, 112, 112A; D-289): term, asset, securities transaction tax on the buy and the sale, how the lot was acquired (capitalgains.*). A bucket no row covers is refused, never charged with total income

Whether a capital-gains bucket is short-term or long-term, chosen by its facts (1961 s.2(42A); 2025 s.2(101); D-305): capitalgains.asset and trade.transfer.exchange (UNRECORDED where absent). The row's period is counted from capitalgains.acquired.on to the transfer in calendar months (D-303). A bucket no row covers is refused. Not shipped yet: the twenty-four-month period of other assets (s.2(42A) / s.2(101)(a)) — nothing recorded shows an equity share unlisted, and no fund or bond part exists — and the deemed short-term assets of 1961 s.50AA / 2025 s.76 (D-305 C2)
